translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 14.2.2023 (radio)

At the Nato summit they talked about membership applications and Ukraine. The EU bans sales of combustion engine cars. Small children's screen time increased during the corona time. Friendship Day was celebrated on Tuesday. Weather forecast.
## Nato summit

![Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg said at his press briefing that Nato must help Ukraine not only to win the war, but also to defend itself after it.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5109,h_2868,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-107226963ea365c8ea88/1676299054)
Open image viewer
Nato Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg. Photo: Kenzo Tribouillard / AFP
The military alliance Nato's Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg has spoken about the Nato applications of Finland and Sweden.
Stoltenberg says that it is not important whether Finland and Sweden become Nato members at the same time. What is important is that Finland and Sweden become Nato members.
Stoltenberg said this on Tuesday at the Nato summit in Brussels. Nato Secretary General Stoltenberg said that he trusts that Finland and Sweden will become Nato members.
## Ukraine
![Soldier walks in a field in Ukraine.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5107,h_2867,x_0,y_533/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-107261763eb6071b749b/1676370296)
Open image viewer
Fighting in Ukraine continues. Photo: Lehtikuva
At the Nato summit they also talked about helping Ukraine. Norway says that Norway will donate 8 Leopard battle tanks to Ukraine.
The US Defence Secretary said that Ukraine quickly needs more military help.
Fighting in Ukraine continues. Russia has attacked especially in the Bakhmut area in Donetsk. Ukrainians have been defending the town for many months already.
## Ban on combustion engine cars
![Cars in a car dealership.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_282/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-10100786328a353a6801/1663608715)
Open image viewer
In 2035 new cars must be emission-free. Photo: Fanega Jorge González / Yle
The EU bans sales of combustion engine cars.
The EU Parliament approved on Tuesday the decision that sales of combustion engine cars will be banned in the EU in 2035. By then all new cars must be emission-free.
The decision was made in an EU Parliament vote with 340 votes to 279. Many opponents of the ban were worried about jobs in the European car industry.
## Children's screen time
![A child lies on a sofa and watches a tablet.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4288,h_2412,x_0,y_221/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5281375c013d7b744f4/1543585197)
Open image viewer
The recommendation is that children aged 2-6 should have screen time of at most one hour a day.  Photo: Mostphotos
Small children's screen time increased during the corona time. This is what a study by the University of Jyväskylä says.

The World Health Organization's recommendation is that children aged 2-6 should have screen time of at most one hour a day. During the corona time as many as 70 percent of small children watched programmes or played video games for longer than the health recommendation. The reason may be that because of corona restrictions they had to be at home a lot.
The study also noticed that in families with high incomes and educated families, screen time rules were followed better than in other families.
## Friendship Day
![Two red hearts.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_7111,h_4000,x_888,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-914912620a3f7f1b5dd/1644839031)
Open image viewer
Friendship Day is a fairly new holiday in Finland.  Photo: ullstein bild / AOP
Today, Tuesday, Friendship Day has been celebrated. Friendship Day is every year on 14 February.

In many other countries Saint Valentine's Day has been celebrated, that is, the feast of love. In Finland the theme of the day is friendship. Many people remember a friend, for example, with a message.
Friendship Day is a fairly new holiday in Finland. It got into the calendar in 1987.
## The weather
![Wednesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12688999)
Open image viewer
On Wednesday it is mild, that is, quite warm, even though it is winter.
On Wednesday the weather is mostly cloudy. It is dry, that is, it does not rain. In northern Lapland the sun may shine. The temperature is between -3 and +2 degrees.
